physics_check._rule: verdict on the RPM-matched difference (250 rpm bins, >= 50 rows each side, weighted by the smaller count); |diff| / normal sd < 0.1 counts as negligible

headline.statement: This dataset cannot separate fault from session: each class is one recording session, so every split, temporal or random, tests on the training session. On the random-row split the operating point alone (no exhaust chemistry) scores 0.737, the same as all variables (0.745), so a random-split accuracy measures session recognition. On the temporal split, operating-point-only falls to 0.422 and combustion-only to 0.420: neither generalises to the later operating points of the same session. Class 3 (low voltage) is a noised copy of class 2 (lean), so 2 vs 3 is a coin flip.
